title: Why Smart People Join Dangerous Cults

scenes.caption: Doctors, lawyers, teachers — smart, educated people join cults every year. And they don't join because they're stupid.
scenes.caption_roman: Doctors, lawyers, teachers — smart, educated people join cults every year. And they don't join because they're stupid.

scenes.caption: They join because they're in pain. A breakup, a death, a lost job — the exact moment their guard is down.
scenes.caption_roman: They join because they're in pain. A breakup, a death, a lost job — the exact moment their guard is down.

scenes.caption: Step one: love bombing. Strangers flood them with acceptance, purpose, and a family they never had.
scenes.caption_roman: Step one: love bombing. Strangers flood them with acceptance, purpose, and a family they never had.

scenes.caption: Step two: isolation. Old friends become 'toxic'. Family becomes 'the enemy'. Soon there is only the group.
scenes.caption_roman: Step two: isolation. Old friends become 'toxic'. Family becomes 'the enemy'. Soon there is only the group.

scenes.caption: Step three: small commitments. A weekend, then money, then a confession. Each yes makes the next one easier.
scenes.caption_roman: Step three: small commitments. A weekend, then money, then a confession. Each yes makes the next one easier.

scenes.caption: Step four: black-and-white thinking. The leader is always right. Doubt becomes betrayal. That's how free will quietly disappears.
scenes.caption_roman: Step four: black-and-white thinking. The leader is always right. Doubt becomes betrayal. That's how free will quietly disappears.

scenes.caption: Intelligence doesn't protect you. Awareness does. If a new group is moving too fast and pulling you from family — slow down. Follow Coercion Files for the psychology they don't teach you in school.
